Hi! I'm not 100% sure, but it sounds to me that regime-specific variance
does not
make sense in smooth transition models. This is because the boundary
between regimes
is not sharp and hence you cannot sharply discriminate variance from one
another. I'm
in a hurry here, just wanted to share that thought. What do you think,
Matthieu?

It seems to be right opinion so function is not ported to STAR and co%
